row1.text: Core reading flow: Home, Feed, Article

brief.text:
ROUND 2: what changed

- Option A's palette, masthead and 'In brief' rail, plus Option B's paper objects (index cards, manila folders), all on parchment.
- Your photos are back: paintbrush jar, sink, binder, folder, typewriter, ring-punched page, archive box and the five source notes.
- Stamps are now inked rubber stamps: double border, worn uneven ink, slight warp, pressed at an angle.
- Handwriting has more depth: it sits on taped, ruled paper slips with real shadows, in ballpoint blue. It is used for your existing Editor's note field, so nothing new is invented.
- Highlighter has ragged ends and sweeps in on scroll.
- No red string or linked-case features. Every page keeps its current sections and copy.

sample.text:
Headlines, summaries, dates and editor's notes are placeholder samples for layout, not real cases. Source names on the Sources page come from your seeded RSS list. Your About text is used word for word.

Press Play on any page to try it. The nav links move between pages.
